text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a famous peak. It's so 
high— The sun is sure to feel much closer 
at the summit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I really did come all the way to Chile. 
Trainer must have been surprised, too—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry to bring this up right now, 
but... there's something I just have to 
find out for myself."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Taking nearly a week off at this time of 
year is something they normally wouldn't 
want to allow.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, saying "if you have something in 
mind," they gladly sent me off without 
prying――)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, I have to find out, no matter 
what. Whether these legs have what it 
takes to reach the pinnacle or not.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Do these legs have what it takes to 
pursue that special crown, or not!)

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide A
text_block_list.text:
Once again, this is an Umamusume 
mountaineering tour aimed at summiting 
Chile's most famous peaks!

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide A
text_block_list.text:
We can aim for a fast-paced summit, but 
the environment will naturally be harsh. 
Let's stay vigilant and aim for all 10 of 
us to reach the top!

text_block_list.name: Tour Participants
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*... I've still got a long way to 
go, but that's pretty tough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—are you alright? Just a little 
further, Mother.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today. 
Everyone, please report your blood oxygen 
saturation levels later. Tomorrow, we'll 
fit in an altitude acclimation training 
hike.

text_block_list.name: Tour Participant A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, my head's been hurting for a 
while now—

text_block_list.name: Tour Participant B
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide B
text_block_list.text:
We'll be reaching the next campsite soon, 
but... Yes, shall we take a short rest?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Mom, do you want some water?

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... No, it's no use, my body feels 
so heavy. Sorry, but I'm gonna have to tap 
out here.

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It was far harsher than I thought. 
Everyone started dropping out one after 
another—

text_block_list.name: Bouquet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I know you can reach the 
summit, Bouquet-chan. After all, you are 
my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide A
text_block_list.text:
Now, today is finally the day we summit. 
The weather is calm, but the wind is a bit 
strong, so let us proceed steadily.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide B
text_block_list.text:
“And even if it is just the four of us, 
let us achieve the summit.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... gh!

text_block_list.name: Tour Participant B
text_block_list.text:
...! I-I'm sorry... Hold on, just a 
moment—

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide A
text_block_list.text:
She says her legs feel like lead with even 
a single step. It's unfortunate, but she 
will be retiring here.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide B
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you all right, Bouquet-san? Please 
don't push yourself too hard."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I am fine. My body feels heavy, but... it 
moves well enough."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Right before my limit—but I can still 
move. I know this feeling from all the 
medium-distance races I've run.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(From here on out is truly the unknown for 
me. A wall I must overcome to challenge 
this special race――!)

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide B
text_block_list.text:
My... you certainly are tough. Shall we 
push through just a little further 
together?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide B
text_block_list.text:
...The wind is so strong! Hold tight to 
the fixed rope!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes—! ...Hah, hah, hah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(My legs won't move the way I want them 
to! I can't even—breathe properly...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(So this is what it means to push beyond 
the limit...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...My legs... won't lift—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I have to do this—for the person kinder 
than anyone else, who embraced me and told 
me to just be myself.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I absolutely must—give her a special 
blossom...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I have to become someone who can win!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ha— Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...I finally... reached it—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...The sun... so blinding—

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide B
text_block_list.text: ...What a lovely view.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—I can see a long, long road. The sky 
feels so close now.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—I'm sure everything will be fine.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I will make sure to give you— a very 
special flower.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

On the day she was scheduled to return 
from Chile, Curren Bouquetd'or came to 
visit as I was prepping work in the 
Trainer Dorms.

Beside her is a large suitcase... Could it 
be that she came straight here right after 
returning to the country?
choice_data_list: Welcome back! What on earth happened?
Welcome back! What in the world happened?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
There is something important I need to 
talk to you about.

—Suddenly, I realize. Her eyes were filled 
with anticipation—and resolve.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me run in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So, I want to gather a bouquet of special 
chrysanthemums that bloom in spring—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I know full well what a high wall it is. 
The longest GⅠ distance at 3,200 meters—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Only one Tiara Umamusume has ever won it. 
In recent years, not a single one has even 
placed in the top three.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, it's a distance on a whole 
different level from her usual 
battlegrounds—even with good stamina, it 
might prove difficult.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yet, even so—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I wish to put this body to use to achieve 
a great feat. A special feat worthy of 
earning a special flower.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Because I felt... that if it's me, I can 
do it...!

All I heard was that she went mountain 
climbing in Chile. What she saw and felt 
there, I do not know.

However—I can tell that from this, you 
have gained a measure of confidence.

What drove her that far— Could it be that 
she, too, had begun to feel anxious about 
the path she'd walked up until now?

Swallowing my anxiety, I looked into her 
eyes. Even if only in appearance, I didn't 
want to be a pathetic Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...All right. Let's give it a try.

text_block_list.text:
Compared to many Tiara route Umamusume who 
hone their power and speed, she certainly 
possesses a good amount of stamina.

"Even so, whether we can truly compete at 
3,200 meters is another question—"
choice_data_list:
(No, my job is to get her ready to 
compete)

(No, my job is to get her ready to 
compete.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I will not... let you leave like this.)

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see. Taking on the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
is it? ...What an intriguing girl.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, you don't need me anymore. I 
shall return to being just an advisor.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Spending time with her lately made me 
realize. If she were only with me, she 
never would've found the resolve to 
challenge such a massive wall.

As I stood bewildered by his vague, 
elusive words, he fixed his gaze intently 
on me, as if gently reprimanding me.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen here. The presence of one's 
Trainer is far greater than we might 
think."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Do not lose sight of that responsibility 
and honor, and hold them firmly in your 
heart.

"The bond between an Umamusume and her 
Trainer is one of shared destiny. A 
Trainer must be someone who 
single-mindedly supports them for the sake 
of their dreams."

Reflecting on the Chief Trainer's words, 
perhaps there are still things about me... 
that I haven't fully understood from his 
perspective.
choice_data_list:
(...No, for now I just need to focus on 
what I have to do)

text_block_list.text:
If I made her feel anxious, that is my 
responsibility. Above all, she was trying 
so desperately hard.

—If I can't answer those feelings, what 
kind of trainer would I be?

Steeling my resolve once more, I headed to 
the desk. We conquered the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)—next time, next time for sure, I 
will make her shine brighter than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. The Nikkei Sho is a prep race for 
the Tenno Sho (Spring), after all.”

The next day, I proposed a new race 
rotation to her aimed at the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

The plan is to cancel our entry for the 
Kyoto Kinen and aim for the Nikkei Sho 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
First delivering results in a 2,500m 
long-distance race before heading into 
spring—would that be the general outline?

I wanted her to experience a long-distance 
race in the Nikkei Sho, and build up from 
there toward the Tenno Sho (Spring).
choice_data_list:
Tough days are ahead, but I wonder if I 
can handle it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—of course.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If it's to bundle the spring 
chrysanthemums, I can do my best. As much 
as it takes.

Next, instead of the Kyoto Kinen, I'll go 
for the Nikkei Sho. To claim that special 
spring crown— I want to charge forward 
without flinching!
